organizations.tagline: Weekly food packages for 640 families across Ocean County.
organizations.storyMd:
Ezras Shabbos began in 2009 with four families and a station wagon. Today a volunteer crew of ninety packs and delivers groceries every Thursday night, quietly, to households that would otherwise choose between rent and a Shabbos table.

Every family is referred by a rav, a principal or a social worker. No family is ever asked to appear in a photograph, and no name leaves the packing room.

departments.name: Weekly Food Packages
departments.description: The core program: groceries delivered every Thursday to 640 households.

departments.name: Emergency Fund
departments.description: Same-week help for a family hit by a job loss, a hospitalisation or an eviction notice. Routed separately so it is never spent on operations.

departments.name: Vehicle & Logistics
departments.description: The two refrigerated vans, the warehouse lease and the fuel that moves it all.

campaigns.title: Sponsor a family for a month
campaigns.description: Four weeks of groceries for one household. The most common gift we receive, and the one we can plan around.

campaigns.title: Yom Tov drive
campaigns.description: Meat, wine and staples for Rosh Hashana and Succos, on top of the ordinary weekly package.

campaigns.title: Replacement delivery van
campaigns.description: Our 2011 van failed inspection in June. A refrigerated replacement runs $38,000 and covers roughly 180 deliveries a week.

paymentMethods.instructionsMd: Send from your bank's Zelle screen to **give@example.org**. Put the campaign name in the memo so it reaches the right department.
This address is watched daily and is spent only on same-week family emergencies.

Make payable to **Ezras Shabbos Network Inc.**

18 Cedar Bridge Ave, Lakewood, NJ 08701

endorsements.quote: I have referred families to Ezras Shabbos for eleven years. Not once has a family's name become known outside that room.

organizations.tagline: Hospital apartments, hot meals and medical referrals in five boroughs.
organizations.storyMd: Families come to New York for treatment and discover the second problem: where to sleep, what to eat, and who to ask. Keren Refuah keeps eleven apartments within walking distance of four hospitals, runs a kosher meal delivery into six units, and staffs a referral line that has taken more than 14,000 calls.

organizations.tagline: Wedding and first-apartment costs for families who cannot cover them.
organizations.storyMd: A wedding should not begin with a loan the family cannot service. Yad L'Kallah works with six local rabbanim who refer families confidentially; we cover hall deposits, basic furniture and linens, and never the extras.

organizations.legalName: Gemach Keren Hashem of Monsey Inc.
organizations.tagline: Interest-free loans up to $10,000, repaid on a schedule you set.
organizations.storyMd: A free loan is not charity and is not meant to feel like it. We hold roughly $2.4M in a revolving fund; 96% of it is repaid and lent again. Applications are reviewed within four business days.

campaigns.title: Grow the fund
campaigns.description: Every dollar added is lent roughly 1.6 times a year. We are turning away applicants for the first time since 2019.

organizations.tagline: Standing beside 84 families who have lost a parent.
organizations.storyMd: We do three things and only three: a monthly stipend that does not taper, camp and yeshiva tuition for the children, and a call before every Yom Tov from someone who remembers the family's name.

organizations.legalName: American Friends of Tiferes Yerushalayim Inc.
organizations.tagline: The US entity through which American donors reach Tiferes Yerushalayim.
organizations.storyMd: We exist for one reason: so that a US donor can support the work in Jerusalem and receive a receipt that stands up on a US return.

organizations.tagline: Food, tuition and heating support for 300 families in Jerusalem.
organizations.storyMd: Registered as an Israeli amuta with 46א status. A gift sent directly from the United States is generally **not** deductible on a US return — American donors should give through American Friends of Tiferes Yerushalayim instead, which is listed alongside this profile.
